title: Plot
description: A pen plotter with no machine: on warm paper one pen line draws a Beatles cover as a single travelling-salesman path, then writes a sincere line in a single-stroke Hershey script. Drag across the sheet to scrub the drawing back and forth.
intent: Plotter art as the subject: the real cover is stippled with weighted Voronoi relaxation, joined into one TSP tour, and fed through a motion planner with acceleration and corner slowdown, so the line thickens and pools where the pen slows and two stepper tones follow each axis speed.
